sqlMap.select: SELECT pm.program_id AS programId, pm.program_name AS programName, pm.tencodes, pm.entrance_test_exist AS entranceTestExist FROM program_master pm JOIN admitcard_table at ON pm.program_id = at.program_id order by pm.program_name

SELECT CONCAT('RET,', sv.value, '-', SUBSTRING(um.start_date, 1, 4)) AS retMonthYear FROM system_values sv JOIN university_master um ON sv.university_id = um.university_code WHERE sv.code = 'ADMMON' AND um.current_status = 1
SELECT CONCAT(SUBSTRING(start_date,1,4), '-', SUBSTRING(end_date,1,4)) AS sessionYear FROM university_master WHERE current_status = 1

SELECT sas.application_number AS applicationNumber, pm.program_name AS programName, stn.program_id AS programId FROM student_test_number stn JOIN student_application_status sas ON stn.test_number = sas.application_number join program_master pm on pm.program_id = stn.program_id WHERE
stn.test_number IN (select application_number from student_application_status where binded_application_number = ( SELECT binded_application_number FROM student_application_status WHERE application_number = #applicationNumber# limit 1 )) AND stn.program_id != #programId# and verification_status="REC" group by stn.program_id;

SELECT eec.application_number AS applicationNumber, es.first_name AS name, es.father_first_name AS fatherName, es.date_of_birth AS dob, CONCAT_WS(',', aam.address_line1,aam.address_line2,aam.city,aam.state,aam.pincode) AS address, CONCAT(pm.program_code,'-',eec.application_number,concat('-',substring(YEAR(NOW()),3,2))) AS rollNumber,eec.registration_number registrationNumber, pm.program_name AS programName,pm.tencodes AS tencodes, pm.program_id AS programId, abc2.venue AS venue, DATE_FORMAT(at.date,'%d %M %Y') AS testdate, DATE_FORMAT(at.date,'%r') AS testtime , sas.application_document_path as docpath,pm.entrance_test_exist AS entranceTestExist, CONCAT(paper1,' ',paper2, ' ',paper3,' ',paper4) AS subjects FROM entrance_eligible_candidates eec JOIN program_master pm ON eec.program_id=pm.program_id JOIN entity_student es ON es.application_number=eec.application_number JOIN admission_addresses_master aam ON aam.user_id=es.student_id AND aam.address_key='PER' JOIN student_application_status sas on sas.application_number = es.application_number JOIN admitcard_table at ON at.program_id=pm.program_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT av.application_number, av.program_id, IF(bc.ext='', CONCAT(bc.building_name,if(bc.location =''or bc.location is null,'',CONCAT(',',bc.location))), CONCAT(bc.building_name,',',bc.location,',',bc.ext)) AS venue FROM admitcard_vanue av JOIN building_codes bc ON av.center_code=bc.building_code ) abc2 ON eec.application_number=abc2.application_number AND eec.program_id=abc2.program_id WHERE eec.program_id=#value#

SELECT stn.test_number AS applicationNumber, es.first_name AS name, es.father_first_name AS fatherName, es.date_of_birth AS dob, CONCAT_WS(',', aam.address_line1,aam.address_line2,aam.city,aam.state,aam.pincode) AS address, CONCAT(pm.program_code,'-',stn.test_number,concat('-',substring(YEAR(NOW()),3,2))) AS rollNumber,stn.registration_number registrationNumber, pm.program_name AS programName,pm.entrance_test_exist AS entranceTestExist, pm.program_id AS programId,pm.tencodes AS tencodes, abc2.venue AS venue,sas.application_document_path as docpath FROM student_test_number stn JOIN entity_student es ON es.application_number=stn.test_number join interview_1 iv on iv.application_number = stn.test_number and iv.program_id = stn.program_id JOIN admission_addresses_master aam ON aam.user_id=es.student_id AND aam.address_key='PER' JOIN student_application_status sas on sas.application_number = es.application_number JOIN program_master pm ON pm.program_id=stn.program_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT av.application_number, av.program_id, IF(bc.ext='', CONCAT(bc.building_name,if(bc.location =''or bc.location is null,'',CONCAT(',',bc.location))), CONCAT(bc.building_name,',',bc.location,',',bc.ext)) AS venue FROM admitcard_vanue av JOIN building_codes bc ON av.center_code=bc.building_code ) abc2 ON stn.test_number=abc2.application_number AND stn.program_id=abc2.program_id WHERE stn.program_id=#value# AND stn.called='Y'

SELECT stt.component_description AS paperName, sp.paper_code AS paperCode FROM applicant_program_registration apr JOIN student_paper sp ON sp.registration_number=apr.registration_number AND sp.program_id=apr.program_id JOIN system_table_two stt ON stt.component_code=sp.paper_code AND stt.group_code='PAPCOD' WHERE apr.application_number=#applicationNumber# AND apr.program_id=#programId#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE student_registration SET document_path=#admitCardPath# WHERE registration_number=#registrationNumber#
UPDATE applicant_program_registration SET admit_card_available='X' WHERE registration_number=#value#
